name: What is the difference between mobile home drywall and regular drywall?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between mobile home drywall and regular drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both are gypsum-based, mobile home drywall often comes in thinner sheets (e.g., 3/8-inch vs. 1/2-inch or 5/8-inch for traditional homes) and may feature integrated vinyl wallpaper or v-groove designs. These differences can affect repair techniques, as standard drywall repair methods might need adaptation, particularly when matching existing textures or paneling styles. City Dweller, LLC understands these distinctions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mobile home drywall is often thinner, may have integrated finishes, and requires specific repair techniques compared to regular drywall.
